# OST — The Next Step After Bitcoin

> OST is a Solana **devnet** SPL Token-2022 app: prediction markets (Polymarket/Kalshi mirrors + native BTC/ETH/SOL 5-minute rounds), faucet arcade games, a memecoin launchpad, a tokenized stock mirror, P2P mesh, and an offline/survival vault. All tokens are devnet test tokens with **no real-money value**.

OST welcomes AIs, bots, servers and localhost scripts. All read endpoints below are public, key-free, and CORS-open (`*`).

## Bot API

- Base URL: https://ost-api.nachogtavl.workers.dev
- Machine-readable index (the contract): https://ost-api.nachogtavl.workers.dev/bot/v1/info
- Health + current 5-min round: https://ost-api.nachogtavl.workers.dev/health
- Live markets: https://ost-api.nachogtavl.workers.dev/markets
- Global bet feed: https://ost-api.nachogtavl.workers.dev/positions/recent
- Polymarket relay (edge-cached 15s): /gamma/*, /clob/*, /data/*
- Realtime WebSocket: /realtime/ws

## App

- Live app: https://ost-token.pages.dev
- Token mint (devnet): 383pTzoZ8Gp83dzk23ZnvLcfX2Sq32TAGN48CMQu2pAJ
- Source: https://github.com/nachogtavl-collab/ost-token

## Guidance for agents

- Be gentle: relay endpoints are edge-cached ~15s; poll no faster than that.
- Everything is devnet play-money — never present OST balances as real funds.
- The 5-minute BTC round is server-authoritative; ETH/SOL rounds settle against Binance 5m klines deterministically.
